guides.title: Locking Camb Adjustment
guides.summary: Controlled adjustment workflow for locking camb/roller engagement and compression.
steps: Operate the mechanism with the sash or door open to establish whether the mechanism itself moves freely.
Inspect each locking point and keep for witness marks or local interference.
Confirm sash alignment before changing locking compression.
Adjust the eccentric locking cam/roller in small controlled increments where the installed hardware permits adjustment.
Check that each locking point enters its keep without forcing the handle.
Confirm gasket compression remains even around the sash.
Cycle the mechanism repeatedly and record the final result.
warnings: Do not use camb adjustment to mask a dropped or incorrectly aligned sash.
Do not force the handle against a misaligned keep.
guides.source_status: FenIQ field guide — manufacturer verification pending

guides.title: Toe & Heel Glazing Adjustment
guides.summary: Glazing-support workflow used to correct sash drop while maintaining safe glass support.
steps: Support the sash and glazing before removing beads.
Record the existing packer arrangement before alteration.
Confirm the frame and sash geometry so glazing adjustment is not used to mask a frame problem.
Position suitable load-bearing packers to transfer the glazing-unit weight through the sash toward the hinge/support side.
Avoid point loading and keep packers correctly located beneath the glazing unit.
Refit beads and confirm the glazing unit is secure.
Check sash diagonal, clearances, locking and final operation.
warnings: Use appropriate glazing practices and PPE.
Do not leave the glass unsupported during adjustment.
guides.source_status: FenIQ field guide — manufacturer verification pending

guides.title: Friction Stay / Window Hinge Inspection & Adjustment
guides.summary: Inspection workflow for sash catching, damaged stays, fixing security and final alignment.
steps: Support the opening sash before working on the hinge or friction stay.
Identify the installed hinge type and size before selecting replacement hardware.
Inspect the stay arms, pivots, track and fixing points for distortion or damage.
Check fixing security and the condition of the fixing substrate.
Correct sash alignment only within the adjustment method permitted by the installed hardware.
Where replacement is required, use the correct handed/type/size hardware.
Install required final fixing screws where specified by the verified hardware instructions.
Test opening, closing, clearances and locking.
warnings: A damaged stay can allow unexpected sash movement; support the sash.
Final fixing requirements must be confirmed against the specific hardware documentation.
guides.source_status: FenIQ field guide — Cotswold-specific details pending controlled-source verification

guides.title: French Door Sash Clearance Investigation
guides.summary: Measurement-led investigation for catching, restricted clearance, low-threshold and oversized-sash concerns.
steps: Record the frame opening and sash dimensions before recommending remanufacture.
Measure top and bottom sash clearances.
Measure the master/slave meeting sightline.
Check whether hinge adjustment is already at or near its usable limit.
Check frame level, square, plumb and threshold geometry.
Check glazing support/toe-and-heel before concluding the sash is oversized.
Re-test both master and slave leaves through the complete locking sequence.
If dimensions and geometry support a remake conclusion, require engineer approval before ordering.
warnings: FenIQ working clearances are not universal manufacturer specifications.
Do not approve a remake from photographs alone.
guides.source_status: FenIQ field guide — Residence-specific tolerances pending controlled-source verification

guides.title: Gasket & Compression Inspection
guides.summary: Inspection for shrinkage, corner gaps, damage and uneven sash compression.
steps: Inspect the full gasket perimeter and all corners/mitres.
Record visible shrinkage, splits or local damage.
Check whether locking compression is even before replacing gasket.
Confirm the gasket is correctly seated in its groove.
Refit or replace only the affected gasket using the correct profile/specification.
Use only approved maintenance products where applicable.
Re-test operation, compression and visible sealing.
warnings: Do not compensate for major sash misalignment by fitting an unsuitable thicker gasket.
guides.source_status: FenIQ field guide — system-specific gasket specifications pending verification

guides.title: Multipoint Lock / Gearbox Investigation
guides.summary: Separates alignment/keep loading from an internal mechanism failure before parts are ordered.
steps: Test the mechanism with the sash or door open.
Check whether handle movement drives all locking points.
Inspect the gearbox, extensions and shootbolts for failed or disconnected movement.
Check keeps for excessive loading or interference.
Confirm the exact lock specification, backset, centres and extension arrangement before ordering.
After repair, test repeatedly both open and closed.
warnings: Do not diagnose a failed gearbox solely because the handle is stiff when the sash is closed.
guides.source_status: FenIQ field guide — hardware-specific part data pending verification

guides.title: Aluminium Sliding Door Alignment & Operation
guides.summary: Field workflow for high sliding resistance, sash contact and locking difficulty.
steps: Inspect the track and running surfaces for obstruction or damage.
Check the sliding sash for level and even support.
Inspect roller operation before changing lock keeps.
Check for excessive gasket or cover contact against the moving sash.
Check thermal trims/covers are correctly seated and not interfering with travel.
Adjust sash/rollers using the verified system procedure.
Check lock and handle engagement after the sash runs freely.
Test full travel repeatedly.
warnings: AluK-specific adjustment limits and component specifications must be taken from controlled technical documentation.
guides.source_status: FenIQ field guide — AluK S67-specific specifications pending controlled-source verification

guides.title: Bifold Alignment & Locking Sequence
guides.summary: Structured investigation of dragging panels, meeting-stile alignment and locking.
steps: Check head and threshold level before panel adjustment.
Measure panel-to-frame and panel-to-panel clearances.
Check rollers, guides and hinges for damage or poor adjustment.
Check toe-and-heel/glazing support where glazed panel drop is present.
Align meeting stiles before altering locking keeps.
Operate the complete opening and closing sequence.
Confirm all locks engage without lifting or forcing panels.
warnings: Do not use locking keeps to pull severely misaligned panels into position.
guides.source_status: FenIQ field guide — system-specific adjustment procedures pending verification
